snippet.text:
/-- **Gauss sum of an induced character**: for `f` periodic mod `N`, completely multiplicative,
and zero off the residues coprime to `N`,
`Σ_{b < Nr, (b, Nr) = 1} f(b) e(b/Nr) = μ(r) f(r) Σ_{c < N} f(c) e(c/N)`. -/
theorem gauss_induced {N r : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (f : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hper : ∀ b, f (b + N) = f b) (hmul : ∀ a b, f (a * b) = f a * f b)
    (hzero : ∀ b, ¬ Nat.Coprime b N → f b = 0) :
    ∑ b ∈ (range (N * r)).filter (fun b => Nat.Coprime b (N * r)), f b * e (b / (N * r)) =
      μ r * f r * ∑ c ∈ range N, f c * e (c / N) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `Σ_{b<Nr,(b,Nr)=1} f(b) e(b/Nr) = μ(r) f(r) Σ_{c<N} f(c) e(c/N)` for multiplicative `f` mod `N`, i.e. the Gauss sum of a character induced from modulus `N` to `Nr` is `μ(r) f(r) τ`.

snippet.text:
theorem norm_sq_gaussSum {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    ‖gaussSum ψ ZMod.stdAddChar‖ ^ 2 =
      if Squarefree (q / ψ.conductor) ∧ Nat.Coprime (q / ψ.conductor) ψ.conductor
      then (ψ.conductor : ℝ) else 0 := by

proof_context.conclusion: For any `ψ` mod `q` with conductor `c`, `|τ(ψ)|² = c` if `q/c` is squarefree and coprime to `c`, else 0, proved via `gauss_induced` and primitive `|τ|²=c`.
